# Erdos.p416 — Erdős problem 416

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/416
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/416.lean`, theorem `erdos_416.parts.i`, AMS 11).

Let `V(x)` count the number of `n≤x` such that `ϕ(m)=n` is solvable. Does `V(2x)/V(x)→2` ?

## Statement
Filter.Tendsto (fun x => (V (2 * x) / V (x))) Filter.atTop (𝓝 2)

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
